description: This Java source file defines the SearchAnalysis class which specifies different text analyzers used in Hibernate Search mappings for the OpenMRS project. It contains constants for various analyzers such as phrase, start, exact, anywhere, soundex, and name analyzers, which are used to facilitate different types of search queries on indexed fields.
